verdict.rationale: Firecrawl documents its own asynchronous background jobs, including crawls, batch scrapes and autonomous agent jobs, with webhook notifications on start, progress and finish. A 'monitor check' job type is mentioned, which hints at recurring automated runs, but scheduling and recurring automation setup are never actually documented; most evidence covers one-off async jobs rather than recurring schedules. Missing for 10: documented recurring schedules/triggers, configuration details for monitors, independent or hands-on corroboration of background automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Get notified the moment a crawl, batch scrape, extract, agent job, or monitor check starts, progresses, or finishes. Instead of polling for status, you provide an HTTPS endpoint
